LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1897_Riot_RWP.label: Winchester M1897 Riot
LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1897_Riot_RWP.descriptio: The Winchester M1897 Riot is a robust, pump-action shotgun renowned for its rapid fire and reliability in close-quarters combat. Designed for urban encounters, its formidable stopping power makes it ideal for suppressing threats at short ranges. Embrace its historic legacy as a trusted tool for law enforcement and military units.
